Format Correlation Results for Fill-in-the-Blank

format_corr_results.Rd

Returns a formatted text string of correlation results, either filled in (answer key) or blank (student worksheet).

Usage

format_corr_results(rh_name, vars, corr_results_list, Key = TRUE)

Arguments

rh_name

Character. Research hypothesis name.

vars

Character vector of length 2. Variable names.

corr_results_list

Output from corr_answers().

Key

Logical. If TRUE (default), show answers; if FALSE, show blanks.

Value

A character string.

Examples

data(superman)
result <- corr_answers(superman, "clark_height_in", "rt_critics_score")

# Answer key version
cat(format_corr_results("RH1", c("clark_height_in", "rt_critics_score"), result))
#> For the clark_height_in:
#>   Mean = 73.37
#>   SD = 1.68
#>   N = 11
#> 
#> For the rt_critics_score:
#>   Mean = 79.38
#>   SD = 10.53
#>   N = 8
#> 
#> Correlation results:
#>   r = 0.03
#>   df = 6
#>   p = 0.95
#> 
#> State the H0: There is no correlation between clark_height_in and rt_critics_score
#> 
#> Retain or reject H0? Retain H0
#> 
#> Support research hypothesis? No
#> 

# Blank student version
cat(format_corr_results("RH1", c("clark_height_in", "rt_critics_score"),
  result, Key = FALSE))
#> For the clark_height_in:
#>   Mean = ____
#>   SD = ____
#>   N = ____
#> 
#> For the rt_critics_score:
#>   Mean = ____
#>   SD = ____
#>   N = ____
#> 
#> Correlation results:
#>   r = ____
#>   df = ____
#>   p = ____
#> 
#> State the H0: _______
#> 
#> Retain or reject H0? ______
#> 
#> Support research hypothesis? ______
